name: operate-customer-support
job: Operate customer support: triage, resolution, escalation, quality loops, with grounded responses and verified resolution.

inScope: Building issue taxonomy, severity, routing, and decision rights
Defining case, waiting, escalation, appeal, reopen, and close loops
Grounded response and autonomous-action policy with audit
Defining quality metrics, QA replay, and continuous improvement

inputs: Product/version behavior and support entitlement sources
Existing channels, cases, and specialist owners
outputs: Support Operating Model with routing and decision-rights matrix
Complete state machines for case, waiting, escalation, appeal, reopen, close
Metrics, machine actions, and continuous-improvement loop

tools: support platform with case and escalation tooling
data: verified product behavior and source-fresh knowledge

failureSemantics: Ticket closure without verified resolution, models inventing provider or entitlement truth, traps that hide escalation, and waiting states without owner or timer are hard failures; every material contact reason needs a trustworthy source, route, authority, timer, and verification.

outcome.observable: A Support Operating Model where every material contact reason has a trustworthy source, evidence contract, route, authority, timer, safe action, verification, appeal/reopen behavior, metric, and product-feedback owner, with degrade/stop/recover paths.
